items.title: Earnings live updates: Salesforce, CrowdStrike, Okta stocks soar as AI boom helps lift Q2 results
items.summary: The second quarter earnings season is nearly complete. Nvidia's Q2 results on Wednesday served as a keystone to a remarkably strong stretch of corporate reports.

items.title: Jackson Hole Symposium kicks off, Marvell & dollar stores report earnings: What to Watch
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch on Thursday, Aug. 26, including quarterly earnings results from Marvell (MRVL), Dollar General (DG), and Dollar Tree (DLTR). Meanwhile, the 2026 Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium kicks off, setting the stage for Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's upcoming Friday remarks.

items.title: Why Did Dollar Tree Stock Drop Today?
items.summary: Dollar Tree had nothing but good news today, and investors are wrong to sell Dollar Tree stock.

items.title: Dollar General Advances 5% on Raised Full-Year Outlook, Dollar Tree Slips 3%
items.summary: Dollar General and Dollar Tree are splitting sharply in the same session, and the direction each name is moving tells a complicated story about whether discount retail is recovering or simply reshuffling its winners.

items.title: Dollar Chains Give Diverging View on Pressured Retail Sector
items.summary: Dollar-store chains provided different takeaways on the state of the US retail sector that's facing increasing economic challenges. At Dollar Tree Inc., the company mostly met Wall Street expectations last quarter and left its sales growth outlook for the year unchanged. Dollar General Corp. lifted its view for annual revenue after a quarterly sales beat. Bloomberg's Redd Brown joins to discuss.

items.title: DLTR Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Margin Gains and Higher Comps
items.summary: Dollar Tree tops Q2 earnings estimates as higher comps, better markups, lower freight costs and reduced shrinkage lift margins and adjusted EPS.

items.title: Dollar Tree Earnings Score With Tariff Refunds. Why the Stock Is Falling.
items.summary: Shares of  Dollar Tree  declined Thursday as disappointing quarterly guidance overshadowed the discount retailer’s big win from tariff refunds that boosted earnings.  The company posted adjusted earnings of $2.70 a share in its fiscal second quarter ended Aug. 1, up from 77 cents a year ago and well above Wall Street expectations for $1.15.  Dollar Tree  said quarterly earnings included a benefit of $1.31 a share from tariff refunds.

items.title: Dollar Tree Says Tariff Reinvestments Will Squeeze Near-Term Profit
items.summary: Dollar Tree said tariff refunds lifted second-quarter earnings but warned plans to reinvest that money will squeeze profit in the current period.
